profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Neighborly Software
profile.summary:
Experienced with a wide variety of languages including C#, C, Java and Python. Past experience with Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) and knowledge-based systems and interested in other A.I. (Artificial Intelligence) approaches. Also worked as an embedded software engineer, designing algorithms under extreme resource requirements.

Specialties: Java, C, Python, C#, Lisp

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing a new machine vision system with integrated line-side printer control.
Developing industrial control systems in C# and C++.
Developing AWS lambdas to support a RESTful API and DynamoDB access, using Serverless framework, in NodeJS and .NET Core.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Technical Lead
positions.description:
Developing distributed knowledge-based systems for the US Army and commercial applications.
Project Lead of a team of 5 engineers.
Developed new subsystems and integrated existing subsystems with a proprietary knowledge ­based (OODA loop) artificial intelligence engine.
Integrated systems using a service oriented architecture (SOA) to provide interoperability ranging between C#, unmanaged C++, and java subsystems.
Interfaced directly with the customer to develop requirements and demonstrate product releases.

"Eric is a capable and dedicated developer. During the past 2 years, he was the technical lead for a team building a network monitoring application for the military. This difficult project required integration of a number of complex tools to provide network staff with a clear picture of network issues. Eric did an admirable job on this effort, and I highly recommend him."
-- Larry Lafferty President and CEO, Veloxiti, Inc

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on varied projects needing accelerated schedules, often as the point-of-contact to the customer.
Projects included:
* EAL 6+ secure RTOS driver development
* Linux drivers
* SPI bus driver for Linux and STOS
* USB driver
* RF signal analysis

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Sole full-time developer at an Artificial Intelligence research company.
Continued development on a Natural Language classification system for the Air Force Research Lab using Case-Based Reasoning and Object Oriented design methods in Java.
Implemented case base maintenance algorithms on a proprietary CBR engine.
Designed and implemented a term frequency vector based module for prescreening classification jobs, expediting overall classification.
Implemented a web interface for commercializing a proprietary algorithm using Google Web Toolkit.

positions.title: IT Assistant Co-op
positions.description:
Web developer in ASP.NET, C# and VB.
Collaborated with other co-ops on developing web systems with hundreds of users.
Network administrator (~100 computers), troubleshooting for staff.
